operators.name: upsample_bilinear2d
semantics: Input dtype float32, device cuda, supports strided tensors.
Output tensor shape computed as floor(input_size * scale_factor) for each spatial dimension.
Uses bilinear interpolation formula as in PyTorch upsample_bilinear2d with align_corners=False.
Scalar parameters passed as float and bool respectively.
No bias, no broadcasting beyond shape change.
Applies nn.Upsample with scale_factor=2.0 and mode='bilinear' to input x of shape [16,32,512,256] on cuda.
Output shape [16,32,1024,512], dtype float32, device cuda.
torch.squeeze with no dim argument removes all size-1 dimensions, but since output from upsampling has all dims >1, shape remains [16,32,1024,512].
No numerical change; returns the same tensor object.
Returns final tensor with shape [16,32,1024,512], dtype float32, device cuda.
